note: Adapted from the original English description of Emerson 1925. The original spells the name Kalotermes (Glyptotermes) guianensis, with a single i, differing from the spelling guianaensis used in this list; the entry follows the list's spelling and records the original spelling as well. Type locality Kartabo, British Guiana; both the alate and the soldier are described from numerous specimens from 6 nests, the alate measurements from a single specimen and the soldier measurements from more than 2 specimens (the original gives ranges). The worker is not described.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head length 2.52—2.88 mm, head width 1.18—1.25 mm, the head more than twice as long as wide, the sides straight and parallel; frons steeply inclined but not vertical, deeply cleft into two lobes in the middle. Smaller than K. temnocephalus Silvestri, K. triceromegas Silvestri and K. taurocephalus Silvestri; the original notes that this species is very close to K. taurocephalus and may be that species. The alate is also similar to K. taurocephalus.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head medium light brown, broadly oval, widest behind the compound eyes (excluding the eyes), with numerous setae. Antennae pale (broken in the specimen), segment 3 slightly larger than segment 4, segment 2 about as long as segment 3. Compound eyes large, the distance from their lower margin to the lower margin of the head about one compound eye diameter. Ocelli medium-sized, close to the compound eyes. Pronotum concolorous with the head, slightly narrower than the head, the sides rounded, the posterior margin slightly rounded, with numerous setae. Abdominal tergites concolorous with the head, with numerous setae. Measurements (mm): head length 1.38, head width 1.30, pronotal length 0.69, pronotal width 1.05; queen body length 6.40.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head brownish yellow, darker anteriorly; head long, the sides straight and parallel; frons steeply inclined but not vertical, deeply cleft into two lobes in the middle; with a few setae. Antennae brownish yellow, 11 or 12-segmented. Compound eyes unpigmented. Mandibles brownish black, rather long and stout; left mandible with several teeth, the right mandible toothed only on the basal half. Pronotum brownish yellow, with a few setae, about as wide as the head, the sides rounded, the posterior margin slightly concave. Abdominal tergites with a few setae. Measurements (mm): total body length 5.20—5.59, head length 2.52—2.88, head width 1.18—1.25, antennal length 1.19, pronotal length 0.59—0.70, pronotal width 1.18—1.20, hind tibia length 0.76—0.88, left mandible length 0.57.
